production.model_type: 3 x sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss='quantile') for q = 0.10, 0.50, 0.90 with monotonic constraints
production.target: total tonnes produced in the 7-day period starting at the forecast origin
production.forecast_procedure: conditional model of period production given period operating conditions + origin-known lags; forecasts assume the trailing 7-day state persists (persistence assumption) unless a SIMULATED scenario overrides it; backtests use exactly these persistence inputs

temporal_granularity.inputs: daily records aggregated to 7-day periods / trailing 7-day windows

features.name: prod_lag1
features.definition: actual tonnes in the period immediately before the origin

features.name: prod_lag2
features.definition: actual tonnes 2 periods before the origin

features.name: prod_lag3
features.definition: actual tonnes 3 periods before the origin

features.name: prod_lag4
features.definition: actual tonnes 4 periods before the origin

features.name: prod_roll_mean_4
features.definition: mean of the last 4 period totals

features.name: prod_roll_mean_12
features.definition: mean of the last 12 period totals

features.name: prod_trend_4
features.definition: (lag1 - lag4) / 3

features.name: attainment_lag1
features.definition: actual / target in the previous period

features.name: attainment_roll_4
features.definition: sum actual / sum target over the last 4 periods

features.name: equipment_availability
features.definition: mean fleet availability in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day value, persistence)

features.name: equipment_downtime_h
features.definition: mean unplanned downtime in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: maintenance_hours
features.definition: mean maintenance hours in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: drilling_delay_h
features.definition: mean drilling delay in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: blast_delay_h
features.definition: mean blasting delay in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: truck_count
features.definition: mean trucks deployed in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: haulage_delay_h
features.definition: mean haulage delay in the period (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: rainfall_7d_mm
features.definition: rainfall total in the period, ERA5 (forecast: trailing 7-day total, persistence)

features.name: soil_moisture_m3m3
features.definition: mean 0-7 cm soil moisture in the period, ERA5-Land (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: temperature_max_c
features.definition: mean daily max 2 m temperature in the period, ERA5 (forecast: trailing 7-day, persistence)

features.name: woy_sin
features.definition: sin(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) at the origin

features.name: woy_cos
features.definition: cos(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) at the origin

production.missing_value_rule: forecast refused (HTTP 503/400) if fewer than 84 days of history precede the origin; no imputation

training_window.rule: expanding; each backtest fold trains only on origins whose outcome ends before the fold

validation_protocol.calibration_source: out-of-sample raw quantile errors of the selected configuration on 52 calibration periods
validation_protocol.final_artifact: POST-EVALUATION REFIT: selected configuration refit on all complete origins (through 2026-09-18) with the frozen calibration offsets. Reported test metrics come from the backtest, not from this refit.

production.validation_method: rolling-origin expanding-window backtest, 13-period folds, purged by one period; configuration selected on 2022-07-01..2023-07-01, quantile offsets calibrated on 2023-07-01..2024-07-01 and frozen, metrics reported on origins >= 2024-07-01

shortfall_classification.definition: shortfall event = actual < target x (1 - 0.05); predicted when P50 < target x (1 - 0.05)

production.uncertainty_method: direct quantile regression (P10/P50/P90) + additive offsets (relative to P50) estimated once on the calibration window and frozen; crossing repaired by sorting; coverage checked on the untouched test window
production.applicability_method: IsolationForest on training operating-state + weather features, thresholds at training 1st/5th score percentiles, plus per-feature range checks
production.explanation_method: SHAP TreeExplainer on the P50 model (model contributions in tonnes; associative, not causal)

data_provenance.operations: SYNTHETIC — generated by ml/generate_operations.py (seed 42); not MOIL data
data_provenance.weather: REAL_PUBLIC — ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis via Open-Meteo for the demo mine coordinate

limitations: Operational history is synthetic; real accuracy at a MOIL mine is unknown until trained on real records.
Model contributions and simulated interventions reflect learned associations in the data, not proven causal effects.
Only a 7-day horizon is supported; longer horizons are treated as persistence scenarios by the contingency engine.

exploration.model_type: PU-bagging ensemble of 15 HistGradientBoostingClassifier members; output = percentile rank of the mean member score over the study-area grid
exploration.output_semantics: prospectivity_rank 0-100 = relative rank within the study area. It is NOT a probability of a deposit, reserve or tonnage.

sentinel2.composite: per-pixel temporal median, indices computed on the composite

modis_lst.qc_rule: QC_Day bits0-1 == 0, or bits0-1 == 1 and bits6-7 <= 1 (error <= 2 K)
modis_lst.spatial_sampling: nearest MODIS pixel to the cell centre

feature_recipe.cell_aggregation: Sentinel-2 and NASADEM: mean of pixels whose centre falls in the 0.01 degree cell; MODIS LST: nearest 1 km pixel to the cell centre

study_area.name: Central India manganese belt (Balaghat - Nagpur - Bhandara)

training_labels.negative_construction: Positive-unlabelled: background cells are drawn at random from the study area >3.0 km from any MRDS Mn record. They are unlabelled, not proven barren; unknown != barren.

exploration.validation_method: spatial block CV (0.25 degree blocks, 5 folds) + east/west region holdout at 79.8E
exploration.uncertainty_method: std-dev of member percentile ranks across 15 PU-bagging members; LOW < 5.0, HIGH > 10.0 rank points (project thresholds)
exploration.applicability_method: geographic envelope + IsolationForest on study-area feature space; MODERATE below the 5% and LOW below the 1% training score quantile

data_provenance.features: REAL_PUBLIC — Sentinel-2 L2A, MODIS MOD11A2, NASADEM via Microsoft Planetary Computer

limitations: Positive labels are MRDS point records of mixed location precision; they cluster in two belts.
Background is unlabelled, not barren, so ROC/PR values are indicative lower-bound style comparisons.
Surface spectra and terrain cannot see subsurface ore; no drilling, assay or geophysics is used.
Ranks are relative to this study area only and are not transferable as absolute scores.
Observation window is the fixed 2024 composite, not real-time imagery.
